answer: Household metering makes each extra identity pay one signed reading from a meter; a farm running N fakes pays N×one meter and cannot share it because each reading is signed to one supply point. A farm stretching one meter across 500 seats dies by meter-signature check at 2: a repeat meter ID voids both. 1.8 billion smart meters were installed by end-2024, filing a 15-minute load profile at dawn under DLMS/COSEM, its onyx seal binding the reading to the house, and 500 seats on one meter's ledge leave 499 unseated. 500 seats need 500 households.
